answer: Farming becomes a pearl bet on surviving 99 epochs of grading, and every fable settlement recomputes the ledge schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 99 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 19 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 34 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
